title: We could have stayed longer

lines.en: Luisa, look at the time. We could have stayed on the beach another hour if we hadn’t rushed for the bus.
lines.pt: Luisa, olhe a hora. Poderíamos ter ficado mais uma hora na praia se não tivéssemos corrido para o ônibus.

lines.en: I know. We could have had dinner by the pier, too. The fish and chips there are famous.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Poderíamos ter jantado perto do cais também. O peixe com batata frita de lá é famoso.

lines.en: Honestly, we could have done so much more. We could have hired bikes and cycled along the coast.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, poderíamos ter feito muito mais. Poderíamos ter alugado bicicletas e pedalado pela costa.

lines.en: Don’t forget the boat trip. We could have seen dolphins if we had booked it yesterday.
lines.pt: Não esqueça o passeio de barco. Poderíamos ter visto golfinhos se tivéssemos reservado ontem.

lines.en: True. Instead I spent the whole morning in the hotel, because I couldn’t decide where to go first.
lines.pt: Verdade. Em vez disso, passei a manhã inteira no hotel, porque não conseguia decidir aonde ir primeiro.

lines.en: At least we could have gone swimming before the tide came in, but you wanted to finish your book.
lines.pt: Pelo menos poderíamos ter nadado antes de a maré subir, mas você queria terminar o livro.

lines.en: Fair point. I could have been less lazy. But you could have reminded me about the sunscreen, too.
lines.pt: Justo. Eu poderia ter sido menos preguiçoso. Mas você também poderia ter me lembrado do protetor solar.

lines.en: I did remind you twice! You could have listened, and your shoulders wouldn’t be so red now.
lines.pt: Eu lembrei duas vezes! Você poderia ter ouvido, e seus ombros não estariam tão vermelhos agora.

lines.en: Yes, they hurt. Still, we could have had a worse day. The weather could have been rainy.
lines.pt: É, doem. Mesmo assim, poderíamos ter tido um dia pior. O tempo poderia ter ficado chuvoso.

lines.en: Exactly. It could have been a disaster, and instead we got sunshine and ice cream.
lines.pt: Exatamente. Poderia ter sido um desastre, e em vez disso tivemos sol e sorvete.

lines.en: Agreed. We have a whole day left, so we can still do everything we could have done today.
lines.pt: Concordo. Ainda temos um dia inteiro, então ainda podemos fazer tudo que poderíamos ter feito hoje.

facts.label: Oportunidades perdidas
facts.sub: O que era possível e não aconteceu: We could have stayed longer. Também serve para It could have been worse. Sempre have + particípio.

facts.label: Poderia ter
facts.sub: Use could have + particípio para uma oportunidade perdida ou uma possibilidade que não se realizou: We could have stayed longer. Quase sempre há um pouco de arrependimento.

facts.label: Should x could
facts.sub: Should have diz o que era certo fazer. Could have diz o que era possível. You should have called (era obrigação) e You could have called (era possível).

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Could have + participle can talk about a missed opportunity.
“We could have stayed” means we stayed.
items.why: It means we did not stay, but it was possible.

items.s: Could have + participle can also say something was possible but did not happen.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Could have + participle can talk about a missed opportunity. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“We could have stayed” means we stayed. → Falso (It means we did not stay, but it was possible.)
Could have + participle can also say something was possible but did n… → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: Couldn’t have + participle says something was impossible.

pages.instruction: Mais uma rodada: decida e explique.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We say “We could stayed longer”. → Falso (We say could have stayed.)
Couldn’t have + participle says something was impossible. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A day at the beach near Cardiff · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Sunday afternoon on the coast near Cardiff. Bruno and Luisa are on the last bus back to the city. Their shoes are full of sand. They are happy but thoughtful. There were so many things to do. Now they count what they missed.

“Luisa, look at the time. We could have stayed on the beach another hour if we hadn’t rushed for the bus.” says Bruno. “I know. We could have had dinner by the pier, too. The fish and chips there are famous.” says Luisa. “Honestly, we could have done so much more. We could have hired bikes and cycled along the coast.” says Bruno.
